purpose: Independent service review for Kaluga official cadastral and parcel-oriented map sources.
assessment: Kaluga has an evidenced official municipal/regional cadastral custodian and current NSPD public-map entry point. Bounded anonymous NSPD requests timed out, so no safe native parcel ID, schema, CRS, or polygon was verified. The packet is complete for attempt 1 and runtime readiness remains held.
registryAssessment: Official Kaluga municipal publications quote the Rosreestr Kaluga Oblast office and identify the public cadastral map; the 2025 notice states that the map operates in NSPD and includes Kaluga Oblast. This is local/regional registry-custodian evidence, not proof of open vector access or citywide parcel completeness.
